title: Use FakeLocalDayClock instead of wall-clock (SystemLocalDayClock/DateTime.now()) in test/sync hermetic tests
rule: TQ-6 (pending: extend hermetic-test check to test/)
why: stage_definition_single_path_test.dart wires the real system clock into OutboxSyncWriteFacade under test; its sibling study_day_config_sync_test.dart uses FakeLocalDayClock(DateTime.utc(...)) for the identical facade, showing the fixed-clock convention exists and was simply not followed here. tutored_listener_supervisor_test.dart uses DateTime.now() three times (lines 191, 313, 354) for filler payload values. Neither instance drives a flaky assertion today, but both stand as standing violations of the hermetic-test rule the moment a future edit asserts against the timestamp, and both make the test's inputs non-reproducible from a bug report.
recommendation: Replace `const SystemLocalDayClock()` with `FakeLocalDayClock(DateTime.utc(...))` in stage_definition_single_path_test.dart; replace the three DateTime.now() payload fillers in tutored_listener_supervisor_test.dart with a fixed ISO string.
acceptance_criteria: grep for 'SystemLocalDayClock' and 'DateTime.now()' in stage_definition_single_path_test.dart and tutored_listener_supervisor_test.dart returns empty

corrections: None needed — all cited evidence verified accurate.
